name: Zanzibar
summary: Zanzibar combines picture-postcard white sand beaches with the historic heritage of Stone Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Nomad hubs like Paje or Nungwi offer beachfront coworking and a growing international community, with flexible visa policies for long stays. The main challenge is infrastructure: power and internet outages are frequent outside the main coworkings, and almost everything is imported, which makes daily life more expensive compared to other economic destinations.
